CONTACT_TO_EMAIL.description: Where your contact form messages should go: your everyday inbox, for example your Gmail. It is never shown on your website. Messages start arriving after you turn on **Email Routing** for your domain and verify this same address there. Not sure yet? Type your email anyway; you can change it later.

EMAIL.description: Lets the contact form email you through Cloudflare Email Routing. Free, no key needed. Leave as is.
